products.name: boAt Bass MA-730D Wireless Bluetooth Neckband Earphones
products.description:
Enjoy music and hands-free calls with the boAt Bass MA-730D neckband. Its lightweight neckband design, magnetic earbuds and wireless Bluetooth connectivity make it suitable for everyday listening, travel and work.
Features:
Bluetooth 5.0
Up to 20 hours of advertised music playback
Up to 48 hours of advertised talk time
Up to 280 hours of advertised standby time
Magnetic earbuds
Built-in microphone for calls
Lightweight neckband design
16-ohm impedance
Frequency response: 20 Hz–20 kHz
Charging time: approximately 15–30 minutes (as printed on the box)
Package: Neckband earphones and included accessories as supplied.
Color: Black
Note: Battery timing and charging specifications should be verified with the supplier before publishing.
